'''Bharat Ganeshpure''' is an Indian actor and comedian. He is best known for his comical performances in the [[Marathi television]] shows ''[[Fu Bai Fu]]'' and ''[[Chala Hawa Yeu Dya]]'' (CHYD).<ref>{{cite web |author= |url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/trade-news/marathi/CHYD-completes-golden-jubilee/articleshow/46076554.cms |title=CHYD completes golden jubilee |publisher=The Times of India |date=31 January 2015 |accessdate=25 October 2015}}</ref> Bharat Ganeshpure rose to fame with his performance in ''[[Chala Hawa Yeu Dya]]''.

The typical [[Varhadi dialect]], is Bharat's specialty. Bharat has also acted supporting roles in several Marathi films, most recently, ''[[Chi Va Chi Sau Ka]]''. Bharat also played a pivotal role in Marathi comedy film ''[[Jalsa (2016 film)|Jalsa]]''.<ref>[http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/marathi/movies/news/Marathi-filmdom-gears-up-for-Jalsa/articleshow/50901476.cms Sonali Vinod: Marathi filmdom gears up for Jalsa | Marathi Movie News – Times of India]. The Times of India. Retrieved on 23 July 2017.</ref>

== Personal life ==
Ganeshpure married Archana Ganeshpure on 20 February 2000. They had a son named, Dhruv Ganeshpure.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-05-25 |title='चला हवा येऊ द्या' फेम भारत गणेशपुरे ३ वर्षांपूर्वी दुसऱ्यांदा चढले होते बोहल्यावर, त्याची पत्नी आहे खूप सुंदर |url=https://www.lokmat.com/television/chala-hawa-yeu-dya-fame-bharat-ganeshpure-tie-knot-again-his-wife-3-years-a603/ |access-date=2023-06-19 |website=Lokmat |language=mr}}</ref> He study BSc Agriculture from [[Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth]], Akola.

=== Films ===

Though Bharat has always acted more supporting roles in the movie, but his roles in the movies ''[[Ek Daav Dhobi Pachhad]]'', ''Nishani Dava Angatha'', and ''[[Kapus Kondyachi Goshta]]'' are well-praised by the audience. In ''Kapus Kondyachi Goshta'', he performed the role of villain, which is exactly opposite to his image of being a comedian. In the movie ''Jalsa'', he was seen in a pivotal role.
